references.text: The first of the firstfruits from your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord, your God. Both texts concern bringing the firstfruits to the holy place of the Lord.
The first of the firstfruits from your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord, your God. A parallel command regarding the firstfruits.
Describes a firstfruit offering of the grain harvest that is to be brought to the priest.
The best of the oil and the best of the new wine and the grain, the firstfruits which they give to the Lord. Concerns a firstfruit offering to the Lord.
The place where the Lord chooses to put his name, there you shall come with your burnt offerings and sacrifices. The same theme regarding the chosen place for worship.
At the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his name. The same formulation concerning the place God chooses.
At the place where the Lord chooses to put his name. An identical expression about God's chosen place.
Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce. A wisdom literature exhortation regarding firstfruit offerings.
The first of all the firstfruits shall belong to the priests. A prophetic confirmation of the law of the firstfruits.
The people committed themselves to bring the firstfruits of their land to the house of the Lord. Practical fulfillment of the commandment.
